entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, um, I have an order and I think... I think I need to return it? The website was a bit confusing and I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you tell me which item you're calling about and what specifically is the issue?
It's the VeloFit cycling jersey. I ordered it and it's just the wrong size. It feels way too tight across my chest.
Okay, I understand. A jersey that's too tight definitely isn't comfortable. I can help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
I think so... it's VF8675309. I was hoping I could just do an exchange, but the return page had so many options. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the jersey, delivered 12 days ago. For a standard item like this, you are well within our 90-day return policy.
Oh, it's 90 days? That's a relief. So I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's the wrong size, we can definitely process an exchange for you. I've just initiated that in our system and sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. All you need to do is send the original jersey back, and we'll ship out the new size.
Wow, that was so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Isaac! You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day.
